SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-05-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CAHILL, SHEILA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT PARAGON REAL ESTATE GROUP OF SAN FRANCISCO INC THE COURT FINDS THAT PLAINTIFF RECEIVED THE INSPECTOR'S REPORT PRIOR TO CLOSING AND WAS THEREFORE ON NOTICE THE POTENTIAL DEFECTS IN THE HALF BATHROOM. HER REAL ESTATE AGENT'S ADVICE NOT TO INQUIRE FURTHER OF THE SELLER DID NOT VITIATE THIS KNOWLEDGE OR ABSOLVE PLAINTIFF OF HER OBLIGATION TO INQUIRE FURTHER OF PROFESSIONAL TRADESMAN TO DETERMINE WHETHER THE BATHROOM HAD BEEN BUILT WITH OERMITS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT RETURNED SENT TO DEFENDANT.
